title: The Long Argument
tagline: Eight arguments that never finished — read in pairs, across the centuries that kept reopening them.
thesis: An argument is not settled by being abandoned. Follow each one forward and it is still moving.
blurb: Eight questions opened early and never closed. Each thread follows one of them forward through everyone who took it up, so an argument reads as a conversation across centuries rather than a list of positions — and every thinker on the timeline has a study of his own: the history happening around him, how his books came to be written, what each one argues, and what survived him.
